_note: English Booklet B answers (Q26-65) read off the scan by eye, for the same
reason and on the same terms as review/en-mcq-key.json (build/en_key.py,
CLAUDE.md 10.4, 1.6.1): committed because work-en-ans/ is regenerated, and
this file can fill a gap in what build/en_key_b.py's column reader
established but can never quietly overrule it -- a disagreement fails the
extraction outright rather than picking a side.
build/en_key_b.py's column-geometry reader was tuned against Nanyang's
layout and finds essentially nothing on the nine 2026-prelim schools' shared
third layout (build/en_key.py's own review file explains the same split for
Booklet A) -- 0/40 on eight of the nine, 32/40 on CHIJ OLGS, which uses a
plainer school-authored template closer to what the reader expects. All 40
answers for all nine are recorded here rather than only the gaps, checked
twice against the 300 dpi render (zoomed wherever the watermark crossed a
cell) and, for CHIJ OLGS, cross-checked against the 32 the column reader did
establish -- none disagreed.
Each answer is stored as the list of body lines build/en_key_b.py's
parse_answer() expects, exactly as the scan's own reader would have produced
them: a bare letter for the grammar-cloze section (parse_answer treats an
unbracketed line as a plain word/letter option), a single word or a
slash-separated set of acceptable words for editing and comprehension cloze,
and one line per acceptable sentence for synthesis and transformation --
PLMGS's Q63 and Red Swastika's Q63/Q65 each print two acceptable phrasings
of the same sentence, both kept. Every sentence is transcribed exactly as
printed, school-authored typos included (Nan Hua's Q63 'sigh' for 'sign' and
Q65 'Noi' for 'Not', Tao Nan's Q62 'chose' for 'chosen' and Q65's missing
'by'/'-ly'): these are self-marked reference answers a child compares her
own sentence against, and silently 'fixing' the school's own key would make
this file assert something the scan does not show.
St Nicholas's Answers PDF carries the same stray leading page
review/en-mcq-key.json documents for its Booklet A key -- page 1 is the tail
of the question booklet, and the real key runs from page-002.png (Q1-60)
onto page-003.png (Q61-75).
